show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/24R93w
show.description: On the day of her wedding, Vamika’s world crumbles when she catches her fiancé with her best friend, but a chance encounter with the mysterious and charming Shaurya offers an escape — one wild night that deepens into something more. As Vamika finds solace and growing affection in his presence, she’s faced with an unexpected proposition: to stay, she must sign a contract built on submission and trust. Just as she begins to fall, a shocking revelation turns her world upside down — Shaurya isn’t just a stranger, but someone intricately tied to her past. A gripping tale of betrayal, desire, secrets, and forbidden love.
